text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 19, 2023) for 414 Jarvis Street.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 19, 2023) for 414 Jarvis Street, Folder Number: 23 202894 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 1, 2024.
